limitations: All database access was read-only SELECT through the deployed PostgreSQL web container; no production row was created, updated, deleted, backfilled, promoted, approved, or rolled back.
The account and explicit owner selectors are intentionally broad recheck selectors; the canonical exact 9-table/9-table inventory remains recorded in the prior v1 artifact.
The current post-0055 schema includes the owner/tenant authority table in the broad account selector; this is reported as observed inventory, not as authority readiness.
Zero owner/definition/policy/calendar/scope/qualification rows are an observed production blocker, not evidence that R1-R8 capabilities are complete.
Existing Data Center facts and publications were not hashed or promoted into owner evidence.
This observation does not prove PIT/OOS history, canonical receipts, Promotion, consumer UAT, PostgreSQL race/rollback, or owner/reviewer sign-off.

query_scope.query_kind: table inventory plus SELECT COUNT(*) per selected table

selectors.account_authority_assignment: account_* containing owner, assignment, or authority
selectors.explicit_owner_policy_operator_assignmen: account_/research_/portfolio_ table containing owner, policy, operator, or assignment

query_scope.source: deployed web container Django PostgreSQL connection
